description: [roadmap S11.4] The model type of g_homeLayouts (was SgRecordBank) is named SgHomeLayout after the symbol S10.8 gave the global (log/roadmap/S10/8_merge.md section 2b names g_homeLayouts but no type); its fields (id, x, y, anim, occupancy) keep their names. path to resolution: A model step renames the fields from 8_merge.md section 2b's evidence (re/model/include/sections/c.h, d.h; the port uses VipResident::type / kind / x / y / u00 / sprite_base and SgHomeLayout::id / occupancy).

description: [roadmap S11.4] The defect switch ids spawnObject.cellSearchBound and placeAnimal.zeroFrameCount keep the old function names after the functions became spawnVipResident / updateVipResident: every app session.json records the switch values by id and app_replay replays a recording under them, re/port/defect_profiles.tsv / defect_decisions.tsv, the app's compiled profile copy and integrator.py's evidence map name them, and the ledger output carries them.
